comms_internal: CV. This is a non-derived double-nominative construction in terms of Alpatov et al.’s grammar. In the online elicitation study, most respondents approved the binominative pattern (but many, 7 out of 15, preferred the TR alternative).

AK: Alternative is the TR pattern with the same verb. NOM_DAT is more likely to be used when the Y argument is the cause of the emotion, whereas TR highlight the joy as directed towards an object. That said, the TR pattern is more frequent overall, cf. NP ACC yorokob-: 316 vs. NP DAT yorokob-: 112
